description: NaScTiP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.67 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.16 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-36°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sc and one P atom.
